direction.logline: The About page, performed as pure motion: a studio that designs the brand, builds the website and engineers the systems as one — told with the site's own type, cards, easing and globe, and no interface chrome.
direction.tone: Calm voice, fast picture. The narrator never hurries; the motion graphics do. Every cut lands on the grid, every hold is earned.
references: SaaS launch films: Linear, Vercel Ship, Raycast

type.display: PP Neue Montreal Medium, tracking −0.05em, leading 0.9, stepped lines with em indents
type.body: PP Neue Montreal Book, 30–34 px, graphite
type.rule: No mono, no navbar, no cursor, no HUD — every element on screen is part of the story.

principles: Pure animation and story: no navbar, no labels, no timecodes, no cursor.
Arrivals use the studio's curves; nothing linear.
Big moves take one bar (2.0 s at 120 BPM); micro moves take an eighth (0.25 s).
The navbar's opening move (PRIME, 1.0 s: the page scales down and slides away) is used as the film's reveal, without the navbar itself.
Dither only at hand-overs (the four-front B/W seam train) and in the globe's land grain.

easing.prime: cubic-bezier(0.87, 0, 0.13, 1) — navbar open, card lifts, wipes, the 'Start a project' hover

sound.music: 120 BPM electronic pulse in D minor → F major at the first drop: muted kick + plucks under the head, a full drop on 'One Prime Studio', a breakdown under 'why', half-time warmth under the founders, a second drop on 'everywhere', a final stab and a long tail on the sign-off.
sound.ducking: Music sits under the voice: −9 dB on the mids, −5 dB on the lows whenever a word is spoken, 30 ms look-ahead, 280 ms release. Effects duck −3 dB.
sound.sfx: Synthesised in scripts/about/audio.py in the SaaS-launch idiom: soft ticks, swooshes, slams, glitch stutters, risers, sub drops, the switch, the seam crackle, arc zips, a notification ding.
sound.master: −14 LUFS-ish RMS for social, −1 dBFS ceiling, 48 kHz stereo.

voice.character: An agent, not an announcer: close-mic, level, certain. Slightly fast on lists, slower on the name.
voice.treatment: HPF 90 Hz, +2 dB presence at 3 kHz, 3:1 compression, a 12 ms digital doubler at −22 dB for the 'agent' sheen, short room.

scenes.title: Boot
picture: White frame. A 18 px ink dot pops at centre on the first tick — the About page's bullet.
Crosshair hairlines draw out from the dot (menu ease), and fade as the headline arrives.

scenes.title: Every business deserves…

vo.text: Every business deserves to be found, chosen, and run well.

picture: The page's h1 as four stepped lines (indents 0 / 1.4em / 0.5em / 2.2em), each gooing in as the voice reaches it.
Under it, three outcomes tick in with blue checks as they are said: Found · Chosen · Run well.
A one-line description rises word by word below.

scenes.title: This is One Prime Studio
picture: The navbar's opening move without the navbar: on PRIME (1.0 s) the white page scales to 0.86 and slides down, dimming, to reveal an ink stage.
On 'One' the studio's switch flips on (knob on the back curve) with a white flash; 'ne' rises, 'Prime Studio' slides out — the lockup at 120 px, white on ink.
Transition out: the four-front seam train — white, grey halftone, black, next page — rising in Bayer squares.

scenes.title: 01 — What we do

vo.text: For every business — from a single shop to a growing product.

picture: A hairline draws across; the stepped heading 'Identity, leads / and solutions — / for every business.' goos in.
Three ink 4:5 cards (Identity / Leads / Solutions) slam in on each word, fanned with a tilt that settles, each landing with a punch.
what2: the cards fold into a row and the lede rises word by word: 'From a single shop to a growing product — the scope changes, the standard doesn't.'

scenes.title: 02 — Why we started

vo.text: Most studios split the brand, the website, and the software.

picture: 'Most studios split / it three ways.' goos in.
Three chalk tiles — Brand, Website, Software — fly apart on their words, each tagged with a different agency; a glitch stutter when the last one goes.
On 'one' (the downbeat) the tiles slam together into one ink block, which opens on PRIME to fill the frame: 'Average was / never an / option.' in white.

scenes.title: 04 — Where we are
picture: The ink frame collapses on PRIME into a disc the size of the globe; the land grain fills in from the centre as the ink drains away (Bayer 2 px squares, far side seen through, hairline graticule).
w1: the globe swings to face India; the Hyderabad node lands — rings breathing out, blue core, its name in a pill. The heading reads 'Based in / Hyderabad, India —'.

'everywhere' (downbeat): the globe spins west and arcs fire from Hyderabad on dotted 8ths — Dubai, Singapore, Sydney, Berlin, London, New York, Toronto — gradient strokes on white keylines, a pulse riding each; 'and everywhere.' lands in blue.

scenes.title: Sign-off

vo.text: One Prime Studio. Average is not an option.

picture: Seam train hands over to white. The lockup assembles: the switch flips on with 'One', 'ne' rises, 'Prime Studio' slides out.
'Average is not an option.' rises word by word in stone.
A 'Start a project →' pill fills with ink on PRIME, the arrow nudges, and the address rises under it: hello@oneprimestudio.com.
The content eases away and the boot's ink dot returns at centre.
